mechanisms: Golden apples for regeneration and damage absorption

weaknesses: Vulnerable to sustained falls without mitigation
Health and hunger bars: hurt by mobs, falls, drowning and starvation

characters.continuity: Overwatch series (2016-2024), Overwatch 2, and associated digital comics
characters.summary: Winston in his Primal Rage state sheds his scientific equipment to rely entirely on his immense raw physical strength, vastly increased health pool, and furious melee pummeling.

mechanisms: Greatly increased health while the rage lasts

weaknesses: Unable to use Tesla Cannon or Barrier Projector while in Primal Rage
characters.formDifferences: Replaces the Tesla Cannon and Barrier Projector with vastly increased health and powerful melee claw attacks, while enabling shorter cooldowns on his Jump Pack.
